S035-01.notes: Improvised materials (folding tables, bedsheets, car batteries) signal 'makeshift'. Permanent/luxurious contradicted; specialized unsupported.

S035-02.notes: Contemporaries dismissed it but later measurements bear it out -> prescient. Outdated is the opposite; arbitrary/deliberate don't fit the vindication logic.

flags: minor: key D is the longest choice
S035-03.notes: Surprising slime-mold network result, then engineering interest. A/B/C misstate content (no theory rejected, no second organism, no rail problem).

S035-04.notes: Scarce timber + 'walking' tradition + upright rope-rocking replica experiment -> upright rope transport plausible. A contradicts the quarry claim; C contradicts the tradition's consistency with the experiment; D contradicts the timber point and overstates ('must'). Facts (2012 Lipo/Hunt, 18 people, ~100 m in <1 hr, concrete replica) consistent with reports.

flags: minor: D partly supports that both call types slow reactions but does not establish the 'nearly as much' comparison as directly as A; B and C each address only one call type
S035-05.notes: Conclusion is comparative (hands-free nearly as much as handheld); A gives both increases (0.4 vs 0.5). Data in A correct (1.3-0.9, 1.4-0.9).

S035-06.notes: Only C isolates ground vibration (no airborne sound) and shows a response. A is airborne; B is about frequency; D about timing.

S035-07.notes: Goal is purpose; B states anti-jamming torpedo guidance purpose. Others give mechanism, patent, or biography.

S035-08.notes: Most come from asteroids; contrast/qualification that a few come from Mars -> 'That said,'. Accordingly implies consequence; For example and Similarly don't fit (Mars meteorites aren't an example of asteroid fragments).

S035-09.notes: Series items contain internal commas, so items are separated with semicolons: 'Callao, Peru; and Guayaquil, Ecuador.' A creates comma ambiguity; C lacks separator; D colon wrong.

S035-10.notes: Subjunctive after 'required that': 'every vessel store'. Stores/stored are tempting but incorrect in formal subjunctive; storing ungrammatical.
